name: DESTINI
recent: Destini 在 2026 年 11 月被仲裁庭裁定需向荷兰船厂 Damen 支付约 RM18m，并预计额外计提 RM4.14m 拨备。公司于 10 月底发布 2026 年报并通知将在 12 月 1 日召开第 22 届常年股东大会。此前 9 月，公司曾宣布与 Siemens Mobility 签署谅解备忘录。
notable: 仲裁庭裁定 Destini 需向 Damen 支付约 RM18m，公司预计额外计提 RM4.14m 拨备。
公司发布 2026 年报，并通知将于 2026 年 12 月 1 日召开第 22 届常年股东大会。
公司于 2026 年 9 月宣布其子公司与 Siemens Mobility 签署谅解备忘录。
risks: 公司因不利仲裁裁决需支付约 RM18m，并预计额外计提 RM4.14m 拨备。
2026 财年第四季度净亏损 RM12.28m，净利率为 -19.4%，亏损较上一季度和去年同期扩大。
集团董事经理 Dato' Sri Dr Shahril Bin Mokhtar 于 2026 年 10 月 13 日在公开市场交易 5,000 股。
earnings: 2026 财年第四季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM63.45m，环比下降 24.2%，同比下降 29.7%；净亏损为 RM12.28m，净利率 -19.4%，而上一季度净利率为 4.1%。

recent_en: In November 2026, Destini was ordered by an arbitration tribunal to pay about RM18m to Dutch shipbuilder Damen and expects an additional RM4.14m provision. The company released its 2026 annual report in late October and notified that its 22nd AGM will be held on 1 December. Earlier in September, it announced an MoU with Siemens Mobility.
notable_en: An arbitration tribunal ordered Destini to pay about RM18m to Damen, and the company expects an additional RM4.14m provision.
The company released its 2026 annual report and notified that its 22nd AGM will be held on 1 December 2026.
In September 2026, the company announced that its unit signed an MoU with Siemens Mobility.
risks_en: The company must pay about RM18m due to an unfavourable arbitration award and expects an additional RM4.14m provision.
Net loss for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 was RM12.28m with a net margin of -19.4%, widening from the previous quarter and the prior year.
Group Managing Director Dato' Sri Dr Shahril Bin Mokhtar traded 5,000 shares on the open market on 13 October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM63.45m, down 24.2% QoQ and 29.7% YoY; net loss was RM12.28m with a net margin of -19.4%, compared with a net margin of 4.1% in the previous quarter.
